title: What Makes Good Examples for Visual In-Context Learning?
mechanism: In-context example choice drives VICL quality; unsupervised and supervised prompt retrieval by feature similarity.
evidence: R: retrieval-chosen prompts beat random prompts for in-context segmentation and detection.
adaptation: Fixes the K-shot benchmark protocol (declared support retrieval rule: random vs nearest vs same-module vs same-source) and the labeller's support selection.
min_experiment: In the K-shot track: random vs nearest vs same-source supports for SAM2 video mode; metric H36 inactive IoU spread; result defines the protocol, no kill.
